# PicoSHA2

Private, unmodified copy of PicoSHA2 1.0.1 from the project's pinned local vcpkg installation.
Used for deterministic data-reference fingerprints, including provider-free headless builds.

- Upstream: https://github.com/okdshin/PicoSHA2
- Header SHA256: `b13c180161ffac8d0adc81e033e493c409457c4d1258ab9781ac80579ba3bdd8`
- License: MIT, preserved in the header and `PicoSHA2-LICENSE.txt`.
- SDK and Python packages install the license notice. No public header exposes this dependency.
